headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 26 at 12:15PM PST until November 27 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding expected. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 6-8 feet, sets up to 10 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, through 1 PM PST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, through 4 AM PST Friday. Most
susceptible time of flooding will be around the time of the
morning high tide, around 9 AM today and 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.
Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach
erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peaked this morning just under 8
feet. A long period west swell will bring high surf today, and
breaking waves may reach 6-9 feet with local sets up to 10 feet
on west-facing beaches. Surf lowers to 3-6 feet by Friday
morning's high tide.
